The Role

CircuitHub makes electronics on demand. Engineers upload a circuit board design; we buy the parts, build the board in our own robotic factory and ship it. More and more of that business is now run by AI agents, and we want you to help build them.

These aren't chatbots. Our agents have real jobs:

  • They inspect boards. An agent checks camera images of every panel we build for wrong, rotated or missing parts.

  • They program robots. Agents read datasheets so our pick-and-place machines know how to handle each new part.

  • They watch the factory. They spot stray parts in robot storage, diagnose printer faults and clear stuck machines.

  • They run the back office. They book supplier invoices, chase late orders, explain quotes and triage bugs.

  • They write our code. Most of what our team ships starts in an agent session.

What you'll do

Find a process people still do by hand and automate it end to end: decide what needs judgement and what needs plain code, build the tools, and prove it works before it runs alone. Then make it cheaper, faster and right more often. You'll also improve the platform every agent runs on, and work closely with the people your work serves, from factory operators to finance.

How we build

  • Evals first. An agent earns the right to work alone: blind tests against people's verdicts, shadow runs beside the humans, replays of past decisions. We track accuracy and cost per run, and re-test whenever we change a model, a prompt or the effort level.

  • Agents judge, code writes. Agents return structured answers. Plain code checks them against a second source and makes every change.

  • Classical first, model second. Cheap vision and maths narrow the problem so the model only looks where it matters.

  • Safe by construction. Agents work in sandboxed cloud machines that never hold real credentials, and tool calls are built so a business action can't run twice.

Recent work

  • Image alignment ranks the parts on each board photo. The worst 20% of parts hold about 90% of real defects, so the agent only inspects those. In a blind re-run it caught all 13 defects operators had marked.

  • A photo check for stray parts in robot storage scored 10 out of 10 blind, at about 8¢ a photo. The model it replaced caught about half.

  • Agent tool calls leave durable receipts, so a session killed mid-deploy resumes without sending the same email or order twice.

  • Invoices extracted from supplier emails matched what a person had entered 66 times out of 66.

  • A constraint solver replans the whole factory every two minutes, across robots, ovens and people.

What we look for

  • You've put LLM agents into production and can tell us what broke and how you knew it was working.

  • You're a strong software engineer first. Most of this job is real engineering, not prompting: concurrency, idempotency, data modelling, security.

  • You build the eval before you trust the result.

  • You like the physical world: cameras, robots, parts rotated by 90°.

  • Bonus: computer vision, optimisation or electronics.

Stack

  • Agents: Claude Code, Codex, Claude and OpenAI APIs, MCP, skills in plain Markdown

  • Code: TypeScript (Bun, React), Python (FastAPI, Dagster, OpenCV, OR-Tools), PostgreSQL

  • Infra: Nix and NixOS, Nomad, Terraform, Vault, AWS, Modal sandboxes, OpenTelemetry

Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables.

The role

You will be our first dedicated engineering leader, reporting to the CTO with a direct line to both founders - no layers in between.

Today, engineering at Prior Labs is a small, very senior team. We plan to grow it substantially over the next 18 months, and your job is to build and run that organization.

We want to be honest about what this job is. It is a hands-on operator role: managing engineers, building the hiring machine, setting standards, running compliance, and working closely with our partners at SAP. If you light up at making an organization fast rather than at owning the biggest possible headcount, this is your role.

  • Own engineering standards and velocity: how we review, test, and ship - and how the team gets real leverage from AI coding tools.

  • Own our security and compliance program - SOC 2, GDPR, ISO 27001 - right-sized, so the lab keeps its speed.

  • Own the engineering side of our collaboration with SAP.

  • Treat the deployment layer as a product surface: our models reach customers through a managed API, customer VPCs, and self-hosted open weights, and the engineering behind that needs customer empathy, not just platform craft.

  • Act as a sparring partner to the founders on org design and engineering direction - we're hiring someone who will argue with us.

What we're looking for

  • You have directly led an engineering organization of 10+ people, including through managers or leads, and you can talk concretely about how you built it.

  • You have owned platform or infrastructure scope at scale: serving, APIs, availability, cloud and vendor budgets.

  • You have worked in both startups and large organizations - you can create structure from scratch and hold your own with a very large partner.

  • You have led engineering in a research- or ML-heavy organization and know how research code and production code differ - and how to bridge them without slowing research down.

You'll work alongside researchers and builders who hold themselves to a very high bar - in the quality of their work and in how they work with each other. We move fast and still take the time to do things right.

Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Backend-Entwickler (w/m/d), um unser hochqualifiziertes Entwicklungsteam zu verstärken. Du bist verantwortlich für das Design, die Entwicklung und das Bereitstellen effizienter Backend-Lösungen, die die Grundlage für unsere SaaS-Anwendung bilden.

Aufgaben

Deine neuen Aufgaben:

  • Du entwickelst und implementiert neue Features und Funktionen für das Backend, die die Basis für unser Produkt bilden
  • Du arbeitest gemeinsam mit Deinem Team zusammen, um Herausforderungen zu meistern und gibst konstruktives Feedback, um die besten Lösungen zu finden

  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem Product Management zusammen, um die besten Lösungen zu entwickeln, die unseren Kunden den größten Nutzen bringen

Qualifikation

Das bringst Du mit:

  • Du hast eine Ausbildung oder ein Studium im Bereich Informatik erfolgreich abgeschlossen oder verfügst über eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Du hast einschlägige Erfahrungen in der Backend-Entwicklung gesammelt, z.B. in Deiner letzten Position, in einem Startup oder bei Projekten während des Studiums

  • Du kennst Dich gut mit modernen Programmiersprachen und deren Ökosystemen aus, insbesondere Node.js, JavaScript, TypeScript und MySQL
  • Du hast Lust und Freude daran, benutzerzentrierte und effiziente Features zu entwickeln und das Backend kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln

Unser Stack:

  • Wir programmieren mit Typescript und nutzen Node.js mit Express im Backend
  • Unsere Daten speichern wir mit TypeORM in einer MySQL Datenbank
  • Wir testen und deployen automatisch mit Github Actions und Ansible
  • Unsere Tests schreiben wir mit Vitest und Cypress
  • Mit Grafana und Sentry haben wir immer alles im Blick

Benefits

Unsere Benefits:

  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit Schwerpunkt im Büro (60/40)
  • Vereinbarkeit von Privatleben und Beruf durch flexible Arbeitszeiten

Valuedesk hat die führende SaaS-Lösung rund um das Thema Performance Management entwickelt. Wir sind stolz darauf, Kunden in allen Industrien und in allen Größen zu unserem Portfolio zählen zu dürfen. Zu unseren Kunden gehören neben vielen mittelständischen Unternehmen auch Global Champions wie Dr. Oetker, Phoenix Contact und Körber.

title: Staff Software Engineer - AI
description:
tl;dr

  • After 14 years in construction tech, Lea & Jonas are building the AI foundation for the construction industry

  • 6 of Europe's 20 largest construction companies already rely on Kuro, with leading construction enterprises representing over €40bn in combined annual construction volume using the platform every day

  • Construction has some of the most complex, unstructured data you can throw at an LLM. At Kuro, you can tackle some of the hardest problems in applied AI every day

  • Curious about the bigger engineering challenge? Explore the vision and open problems at kuro.build.

About us

Lea and Jonas scaled two of Europe's leading construction tech companies - Capmo and alcemy - and saw firsthand the challenges holding the industry back. Now they're tackling the root cause: the 50% of construction work still lost to manual data handling.

Kuro is building the AI foundation for construction. We're reimagining how construction professionals get work done and make decisions by leveraging AI to augment back-office workflows and make core data accessible. We are not pursuing marginal improvements, but a step change for construction.

After one year on the market, leading construction enterprises with a combined annual construction volume of >€40 billion use Kuro every day to automate workflows and make faster, better decisions. Backed by an €10 million seed round, we already process more than 1 million pages every month and expect that volume to grow 10x over the next six months.

We are 15 people based in Berlin. You will join a group of technical ex-founders and builders who are ambitious and kind.

Learn more: Join Kuro - Berlin

What You'll Do

Set the technical direction

  • Own the architecture decisions for the platform, from document ingestion to the chat UI

  • Write and review RFCs. The technical roadmap for the next two to three quarters is yours.

  • Make the build-or-buy decisions: which models we use, and which retrieval and orchestration stack we build on.

  • Turn a vague customer request (“show me where the bid deviates from the BoQ”) into a scoped plan with the risks named.

Raise the bar for the team

  • Mentor engineers: Review their designs and their code.

  • Define the engineering standards. Find what slows the team down, in tooling or in the CI/CD pipeline, and fix it.

  • Interview and hire engineers.

  • You have no direct reports. You change decisions in product and in other teams with a written argument.

Build and own end-to-end (AI) features

  • Design and implement new features to solve a specific user problem, such as document versioning or our agentic Chat.

  • From concept to DB schema, to optimizing LLMs, to UI. Own the full development lifecycle of customer-facing features.

  • Manage evaluations and scoring, and perform error analysis on new and shipped AI features.

Build the platform that abstracts workflow building

  • Contribute to the workflow harness, decision-trace standard, and eval tooling so a new use case ships in ~1 month

  • Build reusable human review & approval surfaces where trust in AI output is earned

Work on the construction ontology & project graph

  • Help model and evolve canonical entities of our customers

  • Contribute to entity resolution across sources: recognizing the same requirement, position, or price across BoQs, contracts, drawings, and bids

  • Build features so answers are evidence-linked and auditable, and decisions flow back into the graph

Contribute to scalable data pipelines & integrations

  • Extend our multi-modal ingestion of unstructured documents - PDFs, scans, drawings, and 3D models - orchestrated and cost-efficient at scale

  • Build read/write integrations with customer systems (document management, ERP/AVA), so workflows complete work end-to-end

Projects you would be involved in

Current & Past projects

  • Project & document versioning guaranteeing data lineage in construction projects

  • German tokenizer for construction-specific search

  • Document pipeline ingesting 10,000s of PDFs per day

  • Native BIM/DWG file support: ingesting and processing 3D models

  • Design the ontology v1 + graph schema: core construction entities, evidence links, and per-customer extension model

  • Build out our workflow harness to run agentic workflows for customers

Current Tech Stack

It is still day 0 for Kuro. Therefore, we are highly pragmatic with our tool choices. We believe in keeping it simple and moving quickly. You significantly help shape our tech stack decisions.

  • Web-App: Typescript

  • Database / Vector DB and File Storage: AWS RDS / Trubopuffer / AWS S3

  • Backend: Fastify API + Prisma ORM

  • Workflow Orchestrator: Prefect (Python)

  • Hosting: AWS Elastic Beanstalk

  • AI: Azure / OpenAI, Gemini, Cohere, AWS

  • Obsv., Eval. & Tracking: Langfuse, Datadog

Your profile

This is the perfect role for an experienced engineer who wants to join an early stage company that builds a high impact applied AI product

  • Bring 6+ years of experience as a Staff (full-stack) software engineer or Technical Lead, in a fast-paced environment

  • Have proven experience delivering production-grade applied AI features to customers

  • Take full ownership of solving customer problems by designing and implementing AI features

  • Thrive in a small, accountable team with a high degree of ownership and a drive to make an impact

  • Communicate fluently in both spoken and written English

  • Enjoy working onsite with the team at our office in Factory Berlin Mitte every day

Bonus Points

  • You’ve started a company before or worked at a very early stage startup

  • You built side projects in the past - we’re excited to hear about these!

  • German-speaking (definitely not a must, we’re fully international)

Why Kuro

You’ll join at a point when customer demand is proven, but our product and platform are still yours to shape. You’ll own customer-facing features end to end while building the foundations beneath them, from ingestion pipelines and workflow infrastructure to our construction ontology and project graph.

As Kuro grows, you can grow with it, whether as a leading individual contributor, technical leader or people manager.

 

The Process

  • Talent Acquisition Call – Intro, motivation, logistics & fit (30 min)

  • Impact Interview – Deep dive into your experience, ownership & impact (60 min)

  • On-site Day

    • System Design – Designing under ambiguity & LLM craft (45 min)

    • AI-Native Coding – Hands-on coding with AI (45 min)

    • Final Culture Interview (approx. 60 min)

  • Reference calls

  • Decision

title: Staff Engineer
description:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

About the role

Andercore runs global trade end to end, from sourcing and pricing to sales, logistics and financing, and AI agents do a growing share of that work. Order values are high and prices and stock change daily, so the systems underneath have to be fast, correct and reliable at all times.

As a Staff Engineer, you own our hardest technical problems and set the architecture across teams. You focus on what a fast-growing trading business cannot afford to get wrong: speed, reliability, security and observability. You report to our VP Engineering and work closely with our Senior Product Engineers, QA and product managers. You stay hands-on: you write code, review designs and raise the bar for everyone around you

Tech stack

Java 21 and Spring Boot 3, Python, LangGraph and LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini), PostgreSQL, Kinesis, AWS with Terraform, GitHub Actions, and TypeScript with Node.js, Next.js and React. Including Salesforce, which we are moving our transaction core out of.

 

What you will do

  • Set the technical direction across teams: define the target architecture, write the RFCs behind big decisions, and make sure teams build towards the same picture.

  • Lead the hardest technical work yourself, from design to production, instead of only advising on it.

  • Shape the carve-out of our transaction core from Salesforce into a modern, modular core system, with a migration path that never disrupts daily trading.

  • Make reliability, security and observability part of how we build: monitoring, alerting, incident response and postmortems that lead to real changes.

  • Design how our AI agents act safely on money-touching paths, with evaluations, guardrails, audit trails and human review where it matters.

  • Set standards for correctness and data integrity, including idempotency, validation and testing, together with QA.

  • Mentor engineers through design reviews, pairing and direct feedback, and help us hire by defining what great engineering looks like at Andercore.

 

In your first six months, you might

  • Design the architecture of our pricing engine so it scales with a growing assortment and more markets, and serves correct prices to sales, and later directly to customers, in milliseconds.

  • Lay out the target architecture and first steps for moving our transaction core off Salesforce.

  • Build the observability and incident setup that lets us catch problems before customers or colleagues notice them

     

What you bring

  • At least 8 years of experience building and running software in production, including systems where errors cost real money.

  • Deep backend expertise at production scale in Java or a comparable language such as Kotlin, C# or Go, and willingness to work in Java and Spring Boot.

  • A track record of setting architecture across several teams, through influence rather than a management title.

  • Experience designing transactional, distributed and event-driven systems, with a strong focus on correctness, failure modes and performance.

  • Hands-on depth in reliability, security and observability, and experience leading incidents and postmortems.

  • Experience in a fast-growing company, and a track record of solving business problems, not only technical ones.

  • AI is part of your daily work. Experience building or evaluating AI agents in production is a strong plus.

  • Experience with re-platforming or carving out systems from a platform like Salesforce or an ERP is a plus

 

Practical details

  • Location: Berlin, hybrid

  • Working language: English

  • A learning budget for your development

  • Start date: As soon as possible

We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or any other characteristic. We believe that diversity drives innovation, creativity, and collective strength.

title: Field Service Engineer – Semiconductor Equipment (f/m/d)
description:
Description

Our quantum sensing technology is already operating in customer environments across Taiwan, the United States, and Europe. As our installed base grows and we move from first deployments to repeat orders, ensuring the reliability and performance of every system becomes increasingly important.

As our Field Service Engineer, you'll take hands-on ownership of our systems throughout their operational lifecycle — from installation and commissioning to preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair.

You'll work directly with leading semiconductor foundries, IDMs, and OSATs, ensuring our systems operate reliably and consistently meet their specifications. You'll collaborate closely with our Engineering and Applications teams, combining technical problem-solving with a strong customer focus.

This is also an opportunity to help shape our global service function from an early stage, introducing the processes, tools, and standards that will support our growing international installed base.

Who we are

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

Why join Quantum Diamonds?

Picture this:

  • Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

  • Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

  • Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

  • An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.

Still unsure about why joining us?

  • You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.

  • From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.

  • Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.

  • You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.

Let’s make the invisible visible!

What will you do

  • Install, commission, and qualify our quantum sensing systems at customer sites across Europe, the US, and Asia, working closely with our Munich-based engineering teams.

  • Perform preventive maintenance, calibration, troubleshooting, and repairs across optical, laser, mechanical, electronic, and software subsystems.

  • Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues systematically, collaborating with Engineering and R&D when deeper technical expertise is required.

  • Take ownership of system reliability and technical service, working closely with Field Application Engineers who focus on measurement execution and customer applications.

  • Manage spare-parts availability for your installed base, including inventory tracking, consumption planning, replenishment, and coordination of service logistics.

  • Document service activities, technical findings, and root causes, feeding recurring issues and improvement opportunities back into Product Development.

  • Build trusted relationships with customers by providing clear technical communication, reliable support, and professional service in demanding semiconductor environments.

  • Help establish and continuously improve our global service processes, including maintenance procedures, troubleshooting guides, documentation, and training materials.

What is expected of you

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience as a Field Service Engineer, Equipment Engineer, or in a comparable technical service role, ideally working with semiconductor, optical, laser, inspection, or metrology equipment.

  • Strong practical troubleshooting skills across complex electromechanical systems, ideally combining optics, lasers, precision mechanics, electronics, and control software.

  • Experience working in semiconductor fabs, cleanrooms, or similarly demanding technical environments, with an understanding of relevant safety and operating procedures.

  • Familiarity with laser safety and interlocked systems, or willingness to complete the necessary technical and safety qualifications.

  • Experience with spare-parts management, service documentation, and ERP or service ticketing systems is an advantage.

  • A structured, independent, and solution-oriented approach to technical challenges, even when working under time pressure.

  • Strong communication skills and a customer-focused mindset, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly and build trust with different stakeholders.

  • Willingness to travel internationally for approximately 80% of your working time, primarily supporting customer installations across the US, Europe, and Asia.

  • Fluency in English; German, Mandarin, Japanese, or Korean would be a plus.

  • A degree in Engineering, Physics, Mechatronics, or a related field, or equivalent technical training and relevant practical experience.

Our benefits

  • Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual.

  • Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast.

  • Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active.

  • Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment.

  • Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 30 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired.

  • Learning & development: Your growth is our priority. We provide an annual budget dedicated to courses, conferences, or any resources that help you expand your skills.

  • Ownership & participation: As part of our equity program, you’ll directly share in our success and the value we create together.

About us

QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act.

Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Operations-, Engineering- und Produktionsteams zusammen und lernst die Prozesse kennen, die hinter der Entwicklung, Herstellung und Auslieferung komplexer Hardwareprodukte stehen.

Bei uns erwartet dich kein Praktikum, bei dem du nur zuschaust. Du übernimmst von Anfang an Verantwortung für echte operative Aufgaben, unterstützt unser Tagesgeschäft und hilfst aktiv dabei, strukturierte und skalierbare Prozesse aufzubauen, die mit QuantumDiamonds mitwachsen.

Deine Aufgaben

Du erhältst praxisnahe Einblicke in verschiedene Bereiche unseres Operations-Teams und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt Verantwortung für eigene Themen, sobald du dich bei QD eingearbeitet hast.

Einkauf & Lieferantenmanagement

Logistik & Versand

  • Unterstütze beim Wareneingang und stelle sicher, dass Materialien bei den richtigen Personen und am richtigen Ort ankommen.

Bestandsmanagement & ERP

  • Hilf dabei, Materialverfügbarkeit und Lagerbestände transparent zu halten, damit unsere Teams jederzeit über die benötigten Komponenten verfügen.

  • Pflege Lieferanten-, Einkaufs-, Bestands- und Materialdaten in unserem Odoo-ERP-System und stelle deren Aktualität und Genauigkeit sicher.

  • Unterstütze uns dabei, unsere ERP-Daten strukturiert, zuverlässig und für unser weiteres Wachstum nutzbar zu halten.

Prozesse & Operations-Projekte

  • Identifiziere Möglichkeiten, unsere Logistik-, Einkaufs- und Supply-Chain Prozesse einfacher, effizienter und skalierbar zu gestalten, und hilf aktiv bei der Umsetzung.

  • Unterstütze bei Datenanalysen, Dokumentationen und weiteren Operations-Projekten – abhängig von deinen Interessen und den aktuellen Prioritäten des Teams.

  • Arbeite eng mit Engineering, Produktion und anderen Teams zusammen, um alltägliche operative Herausforderungen zu lösen.

Übernimm Verantwortung

Ob du offene Bestellungen und Lieferzeiten im Blick behältst, unseren Wareneingang optimierst oder dafür sorgst, dass unsere ERP-Daten und Prozesse mit dem Wachstum von QD Schritt halten können – bei uns kannst du wirklich etwas bewegen.

Das bringst Du mit

  • Du bist aktuell in einem Bachelor- oder Masterstudiengang in Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Logistik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Fachbereich eingeschrieben, oder hast ein solches Studium abgeschlossen.

  • Du stehst entweder für ein sechsmonatiges Vollzeitpraktikum oder als Werkstudent für mindestens sechs Monate zur Verfügung.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und zuverlässig und hast Freude daran, Ordnung und klare Abläufe zu schaffen.

Unsere Benefits

  • Mission: Bei QD geht es um mehr als nur großartige Produkte – wir wollen einen nachhaltigen Unterschied machen. Du arbeitest an sinnstiftenden Aufgaben, die über das Tagesgeschäft hinausgehen.

  • Impact & Wachstum: Du steigst in einer spannenden Phase ein, in der deine Meinung zählt. Du gestaltest Kultur und Entscheidungen aktiv mit und wächst mit einem schnell skalierenden Unternehmen.

  • Work-Life-Balance: Erholung ist uns wichtig. Freu dich auf 12 Urlaubstage plus gesetzliche Feiertage.

  • Gesundheit & Fitness: Mit einer von uns finanzierten Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft hast du Zugang zu zahlreichen Fitnessstudios, Kursen und Wellnessangeboten in ganz Deutschland.

  • Team & Kultur: Die besten Ideen entstehen im Austausch. Regelmäßige Offsites und Teamevents sorgen für ein starkes, unterstützendes Miteinander.

  • Ownership & Beteiligung: Über unser Beteiligungsprogramm bist du direkt am gemeinsamen Erfolg beteiligt.

Über uns

QuantumDiamonds GmbH mit Hauptsitz in München entwickelt und fertigt Halbleiter-Inspektionssysteme auf Basis von Quantensensorik. Das 2022 aus der Technischen Universität München gegründete Unternehmen nutzt Stickstoff-Fehlstellen-Zentren (NV-Zentren) in Diamanten, um elektrische Ströme mit Mikrometer-Präzision innerhalb fortschrittlicher 2,5D- und 3D-Chiparchitekturen abzubilden. Neun der zehn weltweit größten Halbleiterhersteller arbeiten bereits mit QuantumDiamonds zusammen, mit Systemen, die in Europa, den USA und Asien im Einsatz sind. title: Senior Supply Chain Manager (f/m/d)
description:
Description

QuantumDiamonds is looking for a Senior Supply Chain Manager to help build the supply chain behind the next stage of our growth.

We are moving from highly complex prototype systems towards repeatable production and global customer deployments. In this role, you will take end-to-end ownership of the supply chain for our hardware systems, connecting Engineering, Production, Procurement, Quality and our suppliers.

You will translate product and production plans into clear supply requirements, anticipate risks before they impact our builds, and help develop the processes and supplier setup needed to scale from individual systems to repeatable production.

This is a hands-on senior role for someone who enjoys both building scalable supply chain structures and solving the operational challenges that come with scaling complex hardware.

Who we are

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

Why join Quantum Diamonds?

Picture this:

  • Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

  • Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

  • Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

  • An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.

Still unsure about why joining us?

  • You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.

  • From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.

  • Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.

  • You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.

Let’s make the invisible visible!

What will you do

  • Take end-to-end supply chain ownership for one or more of our hardware product lines, from prototype and pilot builds through industrialization and repeatable production.

  • Build our Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process from scratch, turning sales forecasts, planned customer deployments and production requirements into one aligned supply plan across materials, supplier capacity and production, in close collaboration with Sales, Finance, Engineering and Production.

  • Ensure critical components are available when needed, balancing lead times, inventory, cost and supply risk.

  • Build visibility across demand, open orders, inventory, shortages and supplier capacity — and proactively address risks before they impact production.

  • Define and track the KPIs that matter, from forecast accuracy and delivery reliability to supplier performance, inventory turns and material costs, using these insights to drive decisions and continuous improvement in regular S&OP reviews with leadership.

  • Develop resilient supply strategies for complex hardware components across optics, photonics, precision mechanics, electronics and other high-spec materials.

  • Work closely with Procurement on supplier selection, sourcing strategies and supplier performance, while building strong operational relationships with key suppliers.

  • Partner with Engineering, Production and Quality on BOM maturity, design changes, component availability, manufacturability and material readiness.

  • Build and continuously improve our ERP/MRP and supply planning processes, including lead times, planning parameters, inventory strategies and material data.

  • Identify single-source dependencies, long-lead items and capacity constraints and establish appropriate mitigation strategies.

  • Help shape how Supply Chain Management develops at QD as our product portfolio, production volumes and global footprint grow.

What is expected of you

  • 6+ years of experience in supply chain management, material planning or operations within a hardware environment.

  • Proven experience taking end-to-end ownership of complex hardware supply chains, ideally from development or industrialization into repeatable production.

  • Strong experience with supply and material planning, inventory, lead-time and shortage management.

  • Experience managing suppliers and complex supply chains with long-lead, custom or high-spec components.

  • Strong understanding of how Engineering, Procurement, Production and Quality work together to industrialize hardware.

  • Solid experience with ERP/MRP systems, BOMs and inventory management.

  • You are analytical and structured, but equally comfortable getting hands-on, making decisions with incomplete information and solving problems as they arise.

  • You communicate clearly and can align internal teams, suppliers and leadership around priorities and risks.

Nice to have: Experience in semiconductors, photonics, optics, precision instrumentation or another complex hardware industry, as well as experience scaling from prototypes or low-volume builds towards series production.

Our benefits

  • Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual.

  • Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast.

  • Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active.

  • Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment.

  • Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 30 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired.

  • Learning & development: Your growth is our priority. We provide an annual budget dedicated to courses, conferences, or any resources that help you expand your skills.

  • Ownership & participation: As part of our equity program, you’ll directly share in our success and the value we create together.

About us

QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act.

title: AI Builder — Working Student
description:
EggAI Labs · Working Student · In Person (Tübingen, Germany)

Designing lifecycle evaluation for nondeterministic domain-specific AI systems.

EggAI Labs

We're opening the EggAI Labs in Tübingen. The Labs purpose is to test new AI capabilities, identify what works, how they'd improve delivery, and then build assets to support teams and clients. EggAI's mission cannot be achieved through one-off client projects alone and the Labs is the way to adapt and scale.

As part of the first cohort, you will join a small peer group and work directly with EggAI's CAIO, a Tübingen alumnus. You will also collaborate with our engineering, product, and project leads, who will bring you insights from client problems, help you understand their context and challenge your solutions for them. Your fellow AI Builders will be deliberately chosen to span different passions and strenghts. You will have room to explore and be expected to turn that exploration into something useful. This is not a client-facing role.

The problem: EvalOps

How do we prove an AI system acts as expected under various conditions?

We will explore EvalOps: the methods and tools used to check whether domain-specific AI systems meet their behavioral requirements. Among the key challenges for operating AI systems are nondeterminism, ground-truth curation, evaluation metric-design, latency and costs. EvalOps need to overcome all of them in a disciplined way.

These questions will guide the initial work:

  • Regression suites: How can domain experts turn traces, code, and prompts into useful evals in a way that scales?

  • Coverage estimation: How can we quantify the gaps between an eval suite and the range of expected agent behaviors?

  • Live monitoring: Is it possible to detect anomalous behaviour in production with a similar precision to regression evals?

  • Eval analysis: How much evidence is enough to act (e.g., deploy, debug, roll back a feature, choose a different model)? You will help refine them, test approaches, create assets, and pose new questions.

The role

As an AI Builder, you will take an open EvalOps problem from investigation to a working prototype, ready to be tested. Whatever your focus, you will be expected to take a problem through to a useful result. Here is what that means in practice:

  • Research emerging AI and evaluation capabilities and distinguish substance from hype.

  • Understand the user, workflow, domain, and organisational problem around the work.

  • Evaluate usefulness, quality, safety, and reliability with appropriate evidence.

  • Communicate decisions and learning clearly.

  • Create assets that other people can understand, use, and improve.

  • Code and build end to end.

This shared foundation leaves room for different strengths and interests. Each AI Builder will then develop greater depth in one of three pillars.

Three pillars, different passions

Pillar

Driving question

Possible EvalOps focus

Product

What should we build?

Workflows and interfaces that help domain experts create evals, inspect traces, understand results, and make decisions.

Engineering

How should we build it?

Dependable and scalable evaluation infrastructure, trace processing, monitoring, and governance tooling.

Data Science

How do we know it works?

Coverage measures, sampling strategies, scoring methods, statistical tests, anomaly detection, and reasoning under uncertainty.

We expect every AI Builder to develop a practical foundation across all three pillars and to pursue greater depth in the one that most strongly matches their passion.

What we value

  • Problem obsession. A difficult question captures your curiosity. You keep returning to it, pursue ideas without waiting for instructions, and care deeply about finding an answer that works.

  • Initiative and follow-through. You turn uncertainty into something you can investigate, test, and improve—and stay resourceful when the first approach fails.

  • Evidence of making things work. Show us something you created, the decisions you made, and what you learned along the way.

  • Independent judgment. You test new capabilities yourself, distinguish evidence from enthusiasm, and change your mind when the findings warrant it.

  • Generosity in collaboration. You explain your thinking, seek candid feedback, act on it, and help others make progress. 

What is required

  • You are pursuing a Master’s degree.

  • You can write code and turn an idea into working, tested software.

  • You can work from Tübingen and communicate fluently in English, our company language.

Relevant fields include Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, Physics, Bioinformatics, Computational Neuroscience, Medical Informatics, Quantitative Data Science, Cognitive Science. We also welcome candidates from other disciplines who can demonstrate strong problem-solving and practical technical ability.

What you will gain

  • Industry insight. Learn what works and what breaks in real enterprise AI systems, with access to problems from EggAI’s client work

  • Meaningful ownership. Take an EvalOps problem from investigation to a working, evaluated solution, with freedom to shape the approach.

  • Close mentorship. Work directly with EggAI’s Chief AI Officer and sharpen your judgment through feedback from engineering, product, and project leads.

  • Room to develop. Deepen your strengths, learn from peers with complementary perspectives, and use modern AI-development tools on unresolved problems.

  • A say in the Lab’s direction. Help establish its working practices, propose new questions, and influence what it pursues next.

  • Competitive compensation, including recognition for exceptional contributions, and a potential path to a full-time EggAI role after graduation.

How to apply

A short cover letter is required.

Your CV tells us what you have done so far, but we're also interested in the why. Use the letter to explain why you made those choices, what drives you, and why the AI Builder role at EggAI Labs feels like the right next step in your career. 

We are looking for exceptional students, and excellence takes many forms, e.g., academic results, research or ambitious projects. Whatever form yours takes, show us the appropriate evidence, be it grades, publications, something you've built or other evidence of impact.

This is an in-person role in Tübingen. We can only consider candidates who live within commuting distance.
